# Jo Wolff — Frontend Engineer

> Personal portfolio and writing site for Jo Wolff, a frontend engineer with fifteen years in the craft. Specialist in design systems, web accessibility (WCAG), and React/TypeScript. Formerly Amazon (founding member of the Meridian design system team) and Airbnb.

## About

Jo Wolff is a lead frontend software engineer based in Seattle. Self-taught, with a background in English and creative writing. Cares deeply about accessibility as a justice issue, not just a compliance checkbox. Winner of a CLIO Award in 2015 for the LA Dodgers Digital Trading Room.

## Pages

- [Home](https://jdwolff.com): Introduction and selected work
- [Work](https://jdwolff.com/work): Case studies — Amazon Meridian, Airbnb OneChat, LA Dodgers Digital Trading Room
- [Writing](https://jdwolff.com/writing): Essays on frontend engineering, accessibility, and design systems
- [About](https://jdwolff.com/about): Background and origin story
- [Accessibility Statement](https://jdwolff.com/accessibility): WCAG 2.1 AA conformance statement
- [Contact](https://jdwolff.com/contact): Email and LinkedIn

## Writing

- [I have no CS degree. Here's what I learned anyway.](https://jdwolff.com/writing/self-taught): On being self-taught, imposter syndrome, and the advantage of an English major background.
- [Accessibility isn't a checklist. It's a disposition.](https://jdwolff.com/writing/accessibility): What fifteen years of building for everyone taught me about what software is actually for.
- [Design systems are a trust problem, not a component problem.](https://jdwolff.com/writing/design-systems): Why the hard part of design systems is human, not technical.

## Work

- [Meridian (Amazon)](https://jdwolff.com/work/meridian): Founding team member of Amazon's enterprise design system.
- [OneChat (Airbnb)](https://jdwolff.com/work/onechat): Full frontend rebuild of Airbnb's internal AI chat tool.
- [Digital Trading Room (LA Dodgers)](https://jdwolff.com/work/dodgers): Award-winning real-time interface. CLIO Award 2015.
